rules.name: MPS sales invoice
rules.head: MINING\s+PRESSURE\s+SYSTEMS|KUSASA\s+PRESSURE
rules.confirm: Is this a tax invoice ISSUED BY Mining Pressure Systems or Kusasa Pressure Systems as the SELLER (their own name and logo at the top as the company invoicing)? Answer only yes or no.
rules.why: MPS's own sales invoice: can be reprinted from Sage

rules.name: Sage sales order
rules.why: Sales order file copy (Polymer / MPS): the order is in Sage

rules.name: Bank confirmation letter
rules.confirm: Is this a letter from a bank confirming someone's bank account details? Answer only yes or no.

rules.name: Supplier invoice to Polymer
rules.confirm: Is this an invoice addressed TO Polymer Liners / Polymer Lining Systems as the customer being billed? Answer only yes or no.
rules.why: supplier invoice made out to Polymer Lining Systems: not MPS's

rules.name: Test cert marked SAMPLE
rules.confirm: Is the word SAMPLE stamped, typed large or written ACROSS this page as a mark on the document (not just a column heading such as 'Sample No' or 'Sample position' in a table)? Answer only yes or no.
rules.why: test certificate marked SAMPLE: not imported

rules.name: Sales quotation
rules.confirm: Is this a quotation ISSUED BY Mining Pressure Systems or Kusasa Pressure Systems (their letterhead at the top, quoting prices to a customer)? Answer only yes or no.
rules.why: sales quotation by MPS / Kusasa: Quotes library

rules.name: COD
rules.vision: Is there a C.O.D stamp (cash on delivery), or the words C.O.D / CASH ON DELIVERY stamped or written, on this order form? Answer only yes or no.

rules.name: Cancelled
rules.confirm: Is this order marked, stamped or written across as CANCELLED? Answer only yes or no.
